description: This PHP source file defines the TemplateHelper class used for rendering Twig templates within the OrangeHRM system's mail module. It manages Twig environment setup and provides a method to render templates with parameters, including error handling.

classes.name: TemplateHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing Twig template rendering in the mailing system

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Twig environment with an ArrayLoader

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Returns the current Twig Environment instance

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a Twig template string with provided context, throws exception on failure
